findings.contract: Single mapping clock per immutable effect identity, phase-preserved for dot_damage
Same caster/name, max_stack=1 dot merges into a running sibling effect and unions non-lazy target labels
Timer consumes next deadline before children; replacement loses old ownership; phase-preserving refresh retains it
At damage evaluation, existing active effect target_chars become explicit hit_to; target rules are not rerun each tick
Explicit hit_to filters living labels; current native route does not bind them to generations
Generation-aware enemy carrier fanout applies to buff fields; damage carriers use separate existing path

next_requirements: Reproduce retained-target versus dynamic-rule behavior with the real timeline observer before porting
Resolve generation semantics explicitly instead of inventing independent per-recipient phases
Preserve same-name union, stack refresh, cancellation/restart ownership and tick boundary ordering
Handle ordinary periodic attacks separately from DoT phase/target binding and ramp scheduling
